title: Executive Helicopter Tours
specs: Views of Pinellas County beaches, Downtown Tampa, Raymond James Stadium
Strict 300lb weight limit per seat and less than 500 lbs for all three passengers
Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult and able to sit in their own seat
Children under 2 can sit on lap of parent or guardian
All passengers over 16 must have valid Photo ID
Intoxicated passengers not allowed to fly
Executive and Pinellas County Beach tours have three person minimum
Isle Tour has two person minimum and three person max

blurb: Guests take helicopter tours over Pinellas County beaches, Downtown Tampa, and other local sights. Tours have minimum passenger requirements and options for before or after hours flights. They also offer aerial photography, surveys, and special event flights like proposals and weddings.
extraNote: No flights in thunderstorms, rain, or low visibility; reschedule at no extra charge if weather unsafe · Arrive at least 10 minutes before departure or risk reservation change · No smoking during flight · Pilot can refuse any passenger · Downtown St. Petersburg Airport
